product_metadata.title: Northwest Woven Tapestry Throw Blanket, 48 x 60 Inches, Gryffindor Shield
features: Warner Brothers' Harry Potter "Gryffindor Shield" Throw Blanket
Detailed, woven throw blanket; decorative fringes around all edges
description: Whether your loyalty is with the House of Gryffindor, or you are in search of high quality Harry Potter memorabilia, this Gryffindor Crest tapestry throw from The Northwest Company is one item you just can’t do without. The regal crest of Gryffindor is beautifully and vividly captured in this 48”x60”, decorative fringe edged tapestry. This MADE IN AMERICA tapestry throw is impressive enough to be framed as a wall-hanging, equally beautiful for bed and house décor, but is also perfect for keeping you warm inside, or bringing to a picnic outside. 100% Polyester. Machine washable.
